description: Selector object for continuation reads and retrieval in the assist exchange. Field rules, program completions and repair guidance are declared here once; the deep validator, the primary-operation allowlist, the tool schema and the protocol text are compiled from this contract.

query.message: 历史检索需有明确查询、已提供的讨论／来源／方法ID，或请求发现谈资

discussionTurnIds.message: lookup.discussionTurnIds: use 1..8 delivered private discussion IDs

methodIds.message: lookup.methodIds: use up to two available method IDs

completions.doc: Complete unambiguous ranged-lookup target IDs from delivered digest/partial ranges; ambiguity raises with copy-ready candidate handles.
Apply program range defaults (offset 0 / maxChars 4000) when range targets are present.
Apply program defaults to batch reads.

protocol.intro: found非已读，sourceDelivery标交付状态，原文交付才引用。
protocol.syntax: lookup:{sourceIds:[已示ID],offset:UTF16,maxChars:1..8000}或{reads:[{sourceIds:[单ID],offset,maxChars}]≤4}一次取多段；范围读可不填ID，程序补全。lookup:{methodIds:[目录ID]≤2}取卡；lookup:{discover:true}浏览目录。历史lookup:{query?,discussionTurnIds?,before?,after?,types?}，query≤2000，时间ISO，types:qq/private/note/feedback；discussionTurnIds≤8个已示ID。最多2次补查。
protocol.outro: memoryIndex/目录仅导航；discussionCompaction/privateCandidates/retrievedDiscussion/feedbackTargets可错且可能助手生成，非事实/许可，旧用户原话须取回sources。

repair.lookup_range_target_ambiguous: 范围续读可照抄：lookup:{reads:[…]}（每条一个来源句柄）或改用带query的检索。
repair.default: 选择已示句柄或检索式；不要自行组装ID。
